title: Third Quarter 2026 Production Report
gist: Glencore's Q3 2026 production report shows copper up 12% YTD like-for-like (3% reported, to 598.6kt) on African Copper and Antamina grades, while zinc (-23%), cobalt (-52%, DRC export quotas, with cobalt now held in solution) and steelmaking coal (-13%, EVR throughput) fell sharply. FY2026 guidance is unchanged but copper and steelmaking coal are tracking toward the lower end, ferrochrome smelters are restarting (+29% QoQ), and Marketing Adjusted EBIT is expected to exceed $5bn.

insights.claim: Glencore's own-sourced copper production YTD 2026 was 598.6kt, up 3% (15.1kt) on YTD 2025, but up 12% after adjusting for the Q3 2025 closure of Mount Isa copper and the 1 June 2026 Kidd disposal (together 49.7kt).
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Headline copper growth understates underlying asset momentum; like-for-like 12% growth is the cleaner read for Glencore's continuing copper portfolio.

insights.claim: Glencore's YTD 2026 copper gains came from higher mining rates and grades at African Copper (+56.7kt) and higher grades at Antamina (+32.3kt), offsetting lower output at Antapaccay (-16.7kt) and Collahuasi (-7.2kt).
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Glencore's copper growth is increasingly concentrated in the DRC-based African Copper assets, raising jurisdictional exposure even as South American assets lag.

insights.claim: Glencore's Q3 2026 own-sourced copper output was 201.6kt versus 197.4kt in Q2 2026, a 2% sequential rise.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Modest sequential improvement; Q4 needs a sharper step-up to land in the 810-870kt range.

insights.claim: Glencore expects 2026 copper production toward the lower end of its unchanged 810-870kt guidance (vs 851.6kt actual in 2025), partly because the original range was not cut for the c.11kt Kidd would have contributed in June-December 2026.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: A lower-end print against an unadjusted range is less weak than it looks, but FY2026 copper will still be below FY2025 — a negative for copper-volume-driven earnings models.

insights.claim: Glencore's copper guidance implies a Q4 2026 production uptick, driven mainly by higher expected grades and recoveries at Collahuasi.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Collahuasi Q4 grade delivery is the swing factor for Glencore hitting copper guidance — monitor Collahuasi operating updates.

themes.theme: DRC cobalt quota and stored value

insights.claim: Glencore's own-sourced cobalt production fell 52% YTD to 13.7kt (from 28.5kt) because of the DRC cobalt export quota regime and a deliberate focus on copper production; Q3 2026 cobalt was 3.5kt, down 20% from Q2.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: DRC quotas are effectively removing a major Western-traded cobalt supplier's volume from the market, supportive for cobalt prices while quotas persist.

insights.claim: Glencore is increasingly retaining cobalt contained in mixed ore in solution rather than processing it into saleable hydroxide, expecting to realise that value once DRC export regulations evolve — effectively building an unsold cobalt inventory.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: A latent cobalt stockpile represents both hidden option value for Glencore and a supply overhang that could hit cobalt prices if DRC quotas loosen.
insights.quote: cobalt contained in mixed ore is increasingly being retained in solution rather than processed into saleable hydroxide, with value expected to be realised as export regulations evolve

insights.claim: Glencore's own-sourced zinc production fell 23% YTD to 547.2kt, driven by Lady Loretta reaching end of mine life in late 2025 (-73.7kt), planned lower zinc grades at Antamina (-69.4kt) and the Kidd disposal (-6.5kt); like-for-like it was still down 13%.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Structural zinc supply loss from a top producer; the like-for-like decline is mostly Antamina sequencing, i.e. a choice to favour copper over zinc.

insights.claim: Antamina is being sequenced for higher copper and lower zinc grades, explaining both its +32.3kt copper contribution and -69.4kt zinc drag in YTD 2026.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Miners are actively tilting polymetallic mine plans toward copper, a quiet signal of where they see relative value and a tailwind to zinc tightness.

insights.claim: Glencore's 2026 zinc guidance of 700-740kt (vs 969.4kt in 2025) is expected toward the upper end despite not being adjusted for the c.20kt Kidd would have contributed June-December 2026, implying a strong like-for-like zinc outcome.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: A roughly 25% year-on-year drop in Glencore zinc supply is locked in for 2026 regardless of beating guidance — relevant for zinc concentrate TC and price outlooks.

insights.claim: Glencore's steelmaking coal production fell 13% YTD to 21.5mt, primarily due to lower plant throughput and yields at EVR in Canada, though Q3 2026 output of 8.0mt was 14% above Q2.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: EVR operational underperformance is the key drag on Glencore's Canadian coal business; the sequential rebound suggests fixes are starting to take hold.

insights.claim: Glencore expects 2026 steelmaking coal toward the lower end of its 30-32mt guidance, with a Q4 uptick from pit sequencing, recent Australian plant upgrades and completed planned maintenance in Canada.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Lower-end guidance after 32.5mt in 2025 means met coal volumes shrink year on year; Q4 execution at EVR is the watch item.

insights.claim: Glencore's energy coal production was 73.9mt YTD 2026, broadly flat versus 2025, with Q3 output of 26.5mt up 8% on Q2 and full-year output expected toward the upper end of the 96-101mt guidance.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Glencore is running thermal coal at full tilt despite transition pressure, keeping seaborne thermal supply ample.

insights.claim: Glencore progressively restarted its ferrochrome smelters — Lion earlier in 2026, Boshoek in September and Wonderkop in October — lifting attributable ferrochrome production 29% quarter on quarter in Q3 2026.
insights.speaker: Gary Nagle
insights.so_what: Restarts signal improved ferrochrome economics in South Africa (power/pricing), adding chrome alloy supply into the stainless steel chain.
insights.quote: Boshoek restarting in September and Wonderkop in October, following Lion earlier in the year

insights.claim: Glencore's attributable chrome ore production fell 7% YTD to 2,553kt, attributed only to 'varied operating conditions', while Q3 2026 chrome ore output of 906kt was 11% above Q2.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Vague attribution suggests operational noise rather than structural decline; sequential recovery aligns with smelter restarts.

insights.claim: Glencore's own-sourced gold production fell 42% YTD to 262koz from 448koz, and silver fell 10% to 13,298koz, with Q3 2026 gold down 6% and silver down 10% versus Q2.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Sharp by-product credit loss raises effective copper/zinc unit costs, a hidden margin headwind just as the report frames production as strong.

insights.claim: Glencore's own-sourced nickel production rose 4% YTD to 54.6kt, with full-year output expected around the middle of the 70-80kt guidance range.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Steady nickel output amid a weak-price environment indicates Glencore is not curtailing its nickel assets.

insights.claim: Glencore expects full-year 2026 Marketing Adjusted EBIT to exceed $5bn, as communicated in its 2 October 2026 marketing guidance methodology update.
insights.speaker: Gary Nagle
insights.so_what: Trading earnings above $5bn provide a cash-flow cushion against weaker industrial volumes in zinc, coal and cobalt.
insights.quote: we expect 2026 full-year Marketing Adjusted EBIT to exceed $5bn
